scope: Local visual and source review; no browser, external messaging, application changes or sibling edits

decision.lead: Make the real hotel the first subject. Use Varanasi as the reason to visit, then make room choice and enquiry the obvious next steps.
decision.rationale: The blue double room has the strongest combination of a clear bed, warm material, identifiable upholstery and usable composition. The lounge supplies a more personal arrival atmosphere. Exterior photos are useful location proof but have tilted street perspectives, adjacent shops and clutter. The Google photographs are valuable corroboration, but the double is only 1024px wide and the family image is visibly wide-angle and darker.
decision.composition: Prefer a property photograph occupying the majority of the opening with a compact hotel identity and a date/guest enquiry bar. Use a separate text zone or a restrained edge scrim rather than burying the bed beneath a giant headline. Keep the hotel name and Godowlia location immediately visible.
decision.mobile: Use a deliberate mobile image ratio and put substantial copy outside the photograph. Do not force every landscape room photograph into a full-height portrait crop.
decision.cropStatus: Exact object-position recommendations below are art-direction starting values from full-size source inspection, not browser-verified final crops.

assetLimitations: No genuine professional video is available in the current curated set. Use intentional still-image motion; do not fabricate a cinematic hotel film.
Most property originals are 1920x1080 and public derivatives 1600x900. Avoid excessive zoom and full-width high-DPR crops that imply detail the source does not contain.
Property lighting is warm and some photographs are heavily processed. Prefer a restrained UI that accommodates the actual rooms rather than trying to simulate a palace or resort.
No useful first-party logo file has been recovered. The current wordmark is an original typographic treatment, not a claimed recovered client asset.

No usable food plating, breakfast, staff hospitality, current exterior twilight, or accessible-arrival sequence exists in the curated files. Do not illustrate these with unrelated hotels or claim them through generated photos.
Current room photos show alternate layouts. A photo walkthrough must distinguish a room category's examples from a continuous tour of one exact room.
Public OTA/Google photo provenance is documented but client reuse rights still need confirmation. Uploader display names alone do not prove copyright ownership.
Do not copy Shree Ganesha Palace's heritage story, courtyard/architecture imagery, named restaurant or services; its design strength comes from facts unique to that property.

verification.method: Viewed four original contact sheets, Google property contact sheet, 13 full-size curated photographs and the full-size temple photograph; read all published-image provenance entries.
verification.browserVerification: Not performed during this research pass; browser slot belongs to the reference-review agent.
